messages:
Ashley - CS: quick heads-up — CascadeTilt onboarding: since we moved them to Dedicated yesterday their 95p latency jumped to ~430ms and token cost spiked. root cause looks like bigger contexts (avg ~700 tokens) + so-far-unoptimized model choice. thinking proactive perf recs: quantize to q4_0, consider swapping to r-instruct-lite for non-critical calls, and add routing rules for short vs long prompts. anyone available to scope a canary?

Sam - Ops: saw the alert. digging into traces — GPU mem ~68%, utilization 44% (few large seqs dominate). error rate tiny (0.3%). big wins here: prefix KV caching + q4 quantization for steady-state, and route <200-token requests to r-base to reduce avg latency. also recommend enabling regional routing to avoid cross-region hops for their EU users.

Diego - Eng: +1 on canary. if quality concerns, do a shadow q4 run first. propose 10% traffic to q4-instruct variant for 24h, compare on our eval set. can do automated drift checks and rollback on quality delta >1.5% top-level metric. snippet to create a rollout:

```json
POST /v1/rollouts
{
  "service": "cascade-tilt-prod",
  "steps": [
    {"percentage": 0.0, "variant": "r-instruct-1.2-fp16"},
    {"percentage": 10.0, "variant": "r-instruct-1.2-q4"},
    {"percentage": 100.0, "variant": "r-instruct-1.2-q4"}
  ],
  "monitoring": {"eval_suite": "cascade-tilt-50", "rollback_delta_pct": 1.5}
}
```

Diego - Eng: also will tune batching: set max_batch_tokens=4096 and target_batch_latency_ms=30 for this tenant. should drop per-token latency variance.

Nora (CascadeTilt): Thanks — appreciate the proactive reach. our main worry is hallucination with quantized models (we rely on high factual accuracy for billing statements). will a q4 swap increase hallucination risk? what's the rollback plan if quality drops?

Ashley - CS: great question. the plan is: 1) shadow run q4 vs fp16 across 5k-10k representative prompts (your 50-sample eval + longer-run samples) 2) canary 10% with automatic quality checks; if metric delta >1.5% we auto-roll back to fp16. fallback to smaller model only for short, non-sensitive routes. we'll run the shadow now and share a perf vs quality matrix.

perf-bot: 1796234200 METRICS — cascade-tilt-prod — 95p latency 430ms, p50 120ms, error_rate 0.3%, avg_ctx_len 702, gpu_mem 68%, gpu_util 44%

Sam - Ops: operational plan (48h):
1) run shadow q4-instruct on traffic mirror (no user impact) + collect quality signals (semantic similarity + key-entity extraction accuracy)
2) enable prefix KV cache for session-heavy routes (config flag below)
3) deploy routing rule: if tokens < 200 -> r-base-1.0 (cheaper, lower latency); else -> primary path with q4 canary
4) canary 10% for 24h, monitor eval delta and latency/cost.

Expected config example to enable cache + routing:
```yaml
tenant: cascade-tilt-prod
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
routing:
  - match: "tokens < 200"
    route: "r-base-1.0"
  - match: "default"
    route: "r-instruct-1.2-q4"
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  target_latency_ms: 30
```

Diego - Eng: I'll wire the rollout and the eval harness. Sam — once shadow run done, can you attach the sample traces to the eval job? I can script the auto-rollback.

Ashley - CS: Nora — can you drop 50 representative prompts (mix of short billing queries + long multi-turn examples) into the shared folder by EOD? we'll start shadow immediately after. Sam will post the canary link. :thumbsup:

Nora (CascadeTilt): will do. putting samples in shared drive now. thanks team.

Sam - Ops: noting action items: create shadow job, enable prefix cache, add routing rule, schedule canary -> aiming for 48h window. will post rollout id here when live.

Ashley - CS: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the single source for updates — please @ashley if you hit any blocker.

perf-bot: 1796234590 ALERT — canary job scheduled by Sam (job id: j-1796234590).
